name: Pseudo-variable
description: A pseudo-variable is a term used to describe a variable that looks like a variable but does not represent one. Instead, it is a special case that has a specific meaning within its context. ``$this`` is the only pseudo-variable: it represents the object that is called.
code:
<?php

    class Elephpant {
        private string $name;

        function __construct($name) {
            $this->name = $name;
        }

        function trumpet() {
            // $this represents any object of type Elephpant
            print $this->name;
        }
    }

    // $trunk represents only the object 'a', type Elephpant, until it is reassigned
    $trunk = new Elephpant('a');

    // $calf represents only the object 'b', type Elephpant, until it is reassigned
    $calf = new Elephpant('b');

?>
